From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement path & MPA outline — next steps (Atlas Health)

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so procurement/legal and your engineering lead have a single place to align. I pulled this together based on the stakeholders you mentioned (you, David Park — procurement, and Dr. Kim from ML). If anything below isn't accurate, please flag and I'll update.

Top pain points you reiterated:
- High latency and uneven tail latencies on the current on-prem inference stack causing timeouts in triage workflows.
- High per-token run cost when scaling to peak clinic hours.
- Lack of predictable rollout process (no easy canary/fallback to cheaper model variants).

Primary goals:
- Reduce 95th-percentile latency to under 300ms for short completions (<=128 tokens).
- Cut per-token inference spend by ~35% through batching + quantization guidance.
- Establish an agreement and test window (pilot) that demonstrates SLAs before Q4 budget sign-off.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level) — milestones, owners, and target dates:
1) Technical deep-dive & data access (scope): Redwood + Atlas engineering — target: 2026-07-21 — owner: Claire / Dr. Kim
2) Pilot environment & baseline run (1 week): Redwood provides sandbox + benchmark kit — target start: 2026-07-28 — owner: sergio_alvarez / Atlas infra
3) Pilot evaluation & QPS/lambda tuning (2 weeks): measure latency/cost delta — target end: 2026-08-11 — owner: Redwood engineering (Monica)
4) Procurement + contract path: outline SOW and preferred commercial terms — target review: 2026-08-18 — owner: David Park (procurement) / sergio_alvarez
5) Exec approval & sign: finalize SOW and begin reserved capacity (if moving to Dedicated) — target: 2026-09-01 — owner: Atlas execs / Redwood sales

Attachments: I attached a compact MPA PDF (redwood-mpa-v1.pdf) and an editable SOW template for procurement to review.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Claire: confirm David Park and Dr. Kim are the right procurement/technical contacts and that the target dates above look achievable.
- Claire: please share any procurement templates or security checklist items now (SOC2 specifics, required DPA clauses).
- I will book a 30-min technical sync the week of 7/21 (placeholder sent).

If you prefer, I can surface an exercise-level checklist for your legal team (redlined terms we see most often) which speeds the procurement lane.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to pilot.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
